_comment: Machine-readable config for scripts/scrape.py. Human context in jla.md. OAI-PMH ListRecords (oai_dc) over the OJS instance: one request per 100 records gives date, authors, subjects, DOI and the galley link for every article. robots.txt asks for a 60 s crawl delay, which check_robots applies. Added 2026-09-16 for the metadata backfill; the 39 indexed JLA papers are a frozen selective set, so this config is for backfills, not the weekly list.
